The structure of Cr₃Ni₃S₆ (reduced formula CrNiS₂) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Cr, Ni, and S centers, each with six geometric neighbors: Cr and Ni are surrounded by six S neighbors, while S is coordinated by three Cr and three Ni neighbors, with Cr–S distances of 2.33–2.49 Å and Ni–S distances of 2.19–2.35 Å. The octahedra connect through corner- and edge-sharing contacts, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph.
